constraints: No free promotion, appointment, rank, authority or capability gain.
Operational staff work must follow current service, knowledge, orders and command authority.
Daily operational action selection belongs to the autonomous heartbeat or exact command processes.
goals: advance slow service history and supported development for named staff and officers
wake exact staff owners when service, assignment, injury or other material thresholds occur
reconstruction_policy: Use exact staff owners, service history, command assignment, relationships, knowledge and causal events. Unknown outcomes remain unknown.
replanning_policy: At each boundary or causal wake, settle supported slow staff development; use the autonomous heartbeat for active work implied by current orders and goals.
safe_compaction_policy: Stable service spans may compact only when no assignment, injury, promotion, battle, information or relationship threshold is skipped.
standing_orders: preserve named staff as exact people
do not turn staff into one-person troop units or auto-promote them
